adaptations.find: Browsers, custom fields, Linux and older receivers use a draft with a Send action instead. No extra Enter or form submission is added to text input.
adaptations.replace: Many browser and custom fields, Linux and older receivers use a draft with a Send action instead. No extra Return is appended to text input, but line breaks included in the text may act as Enter.
adaptations.reason: The source sentence says every browser lacks live editing and that text input can never submit a form. Mac live editing accepts any field with writable Accessibility selected-text attributes, so not all browser fields are excluded, and embedded line breaks are typed as Return and may submit a form or send a message. Corrected at the website owner's request; the rest of the document is unchanged.
